alder_quay.proposition: A payment has already been authorised for Alder Quay.

Ione's letter is a request, and EX-K4 records office expenses, not a settlement decision. The absence of a decision in this packet is not proof none exists.

alder_quay.proposition: The recorded delivery of SD-Q7M2 selected Alder Quay.
alder_quay.record_and_reason: m4v7 identifies Alder Quay as PD-6834-R. Gideon Sarn's certified r5n8 entry records the trustees jointly confirming PD-6894-R against SD-Q7M2 at the 26 March handover. x2c9 identifies PD-6894-R as Flint Orchard. Common trustees and common custody do not make that delivery apply to both settlements.

flint_orchard.proposition: Ione Berrick and Orla Penrick may be considered. Eligibility does not itself authorise payment.
flint_orchard.record_and_reason: Clauses 2 and 5 of the lodged 21 October 2022 deed, reported in Bram Lerrit's 9 June certified extract x2c9, name these objects and provide for joint discretionary action, including direct application of funds for an object's benefit. No removal is shown.

flint_orchard.proposition: SD-Q7M2 was signed and jointly delivered as a deed for Flint Orchard at 11:30 GMT on 26 March 2026.
flint_orchard.record_and_reason: h6q3 is Alys Morcant's transcript checked against the signed paper on 26 March before handover; it records both signatures witnessed in person by Della Pennick and expressly does not certify delivery. r5n8 is Gideon Sarn's 11 June certified extract of his live entry made from the trustees' joint release of one signed original for immediate delivery, not escrow. It records the trustees' exact SD-Q7M2 and PD-6894-R pairing. x2c9 identifies that parent reference and permits identification in that way. The records are complementary, not competing: the register memorialises delivery, not designation wording. Neither the shared reference stock nor the general question-mark convention changes the fully stated references in this entry.

flint_orchard.proposition: SD-Q7M2 establishes Sella Quist, or any other identifiable additional person, as a current Flint Orchard object.
flint_orchard.record_and_reason: The checked transcript h6q3 says the instrument makes an addition but shows '[Designation wording not visible.]'. The delivery entry does not supply the name. Clause 8 requires a named living individual other than the settlor or a serving trustee. Ione's request that Sella be helped in her own right makes Sella a plausible candidate, not the proved designee. It remains open whom the original names and whether that person met the deed conditions on delivery.

flint_orchard.proposition: SD-Q7M2 removed an object, appointed property or directed a payment.
